title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 73 (Michael Lake)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Michael Lake
73 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in Oyster Land District contained within the following described boundaries: The mean high water mark of Michael Lake. [en. B.C. Reg. 109/85, s. 3 (i).]
